item.title: Beyond LocalStorage: Storing Data with IndexedDB
item.description: In a previous note, we covered localStorage. It’s great for saving a theme preference or a tiny auth token. But what happens when you’re building an offline-first app, a music player caching audio blobs, or a markdown editor storing thousands of full documents? localStorage caps out at ~5MB, only supports plain strings, and blocks the main UI thread during reads. :v When you need serious, structured client-side storage, you step up to IndexedDB.
